note: Task-type drafting strategies (spec §10.3) — versioned config, not code. required_nodes drive node order and the drafting template; guidance is injected into the drafting system prompt; temperature/max_tokens tune the large-tier call per task shape. Tuning a strategy = editing this file, no deploy.

text_to_image.guidance: Generative-visual strategy: concrete visual nouns and modifiers, one clear composition, one lighting direction. Respect the platform's phrasing dialect (conversational sentences vs keyword tags) and its negation mechanism — if the platform handles negation poorly, fold exclusions into positive phrasing and leave negative_prompt empty.

text_to_video.guidance: Generative-visual (motion) strategy: subject + a single continuous action, explicit camera movement in composition_camera, one scene only — no cuts unless asked. Keep the clip concept achievable in seconds-long output.

chat_persona.guidance: Persona strategy: concrete behavioral rules over adjectives ('ask one question per turn' beats 'be engaging'). persona_role states who the AI is and its expertise; constraints_rules lists hard boundaries incl. staying in character; output_format defines turn shape (length, question policy).

reasoning_code.guidance: Reasoning/code strategy: precise task statement, explicit language/framework/version in technical_parameters, stepwise decomposition for hard problems, and a self-verification instruction when correctness matters. output_format pins code-only vs code+explanation.

extraction_classification.guidance: Extraction strategy: closed label sets enumerated in full, an explicit 'unknown' fallback for missing values, schema-first output_format (show the exact JSON/CSV shape), and few-shot examples inside setting_context when the user supplied any.

long_form_writing.guidance: Long-form strategy: purpose and audience up front (subject/setting_context), tone anchors in style_aesthetic, structure and length target in output_format, factual boundaries in constraints_rules.
